archiveLeads.name: Pre-1996 Slocan and Ladysmith identities
archiveLeads.finding: Statistics Canada describes SD8 Slocan elimination in 1970 and SD67 Ladysmith elimination in 1972. Both fall outside the 31 immediate 1996 predecessors.

archiveLeads.name: 1946 Gazette district-name index
archiveLeads.finding: Existing project index documents earlier number/name combinations including 5 Creston, 6 Kootenay Lake, 8 Slocan, 20 Salmon Arm, 67 Ladysmith, 73 Alert Bay and 74 Quatsino. Not new artwork.
